summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its October 30, 2026 general meeting, the US-equivalent disclosure of an ordinary shareholder meeting outcome. At the September 25, 2026 record date, 76,908,685 ordinary shares were outstanding; 50,555,253 were represented, achieving quorum. Shareholders approved a share consolidation, floor-amended at the meeting from 20-for-1 to 100-for-1, intended to regain Nasdaq Capital Market listing compliance (49,991,020 for, 554,128 against). A conditional special resolution adopting revised articles reflecting the increased nominal value also passed with over 75% support. No board recommendation or advisor named; no transaction terms.
